edits.text:
[0] Share Purchase Agreement
[1] PARTIES. This Share Purchase Agreement (this “Agreement”) is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, as Buyer. The parties intend this Agreement to set forth the terms on which Buyer will acquire the Shares from Seller. The purchase price payable at Closing (the “Purchase Price”) shall be the full and final consideration for the Shares, except only for any adjustments expressly stated in this Agreement, and no party shall seek any post-Closing re-trading, offset, or recalculation except as expressly provided herein.
edits.name: party_and_purchase_price_intro

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. In consideration for the Shares, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price at Closing, subject only to the specific and express adjustments set forth in this Agreement, if any. Any adjustment mechanics shall be determined solely in accordance with this Agreement and the final closing statement, if applicable, and no adjustment shall apply unless expressly stated in writing in this Agreement.
edits.name: purchase_price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur remotely at 10:00 a.m. New York time on the date that is thirty (30) days after execution of this Agreement, or at such other time and date as the parties may agree in writing. Closing shall take place by electronic exchange of signature pages and wired funds, unless the parties agree in writing to a different location or method. If any escrow or holdback is expressly contemplated by this Agreement, it shall be administered pursuant to written escrow instructions delivered at Closing.
edits.name: closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents, solely as of the date of this Agreement and as of Closing, that: (a) Seller has good and valid title to the Shares, free and clear of all liens, pledges, security interests, encumbrances, claims, options, proxies, voting trusts, or other restrictions of any kind, other than restrictions under applicable securities laws and this Agreement; (b) Seller has full power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby, and, if Seller is an entity, is duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of organization; (c) the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement do not and will not conflict with, violate, or result in a default under any material agreement, order, judgment, or law applicable to Seller; (d) no consent, approval, authorization, order, or filing of any governmental authority or third party is required by Seller in connection with the execution, delivery, or performance of this Agreement, except as expressly set forth herein; (e) except as expressly disclosed in writing to Buyer, there is no material litigation, arbitration, investigation, or governmental proceeding pending or, to Seller’s knowledge, threatened against Seller relating to the Shares; and (f) any taxes arising from Seller’s ownership or transfer of the Shares have been paid or will be timely paid when due, except as expressly disclosed in writing to Buyer. Any representation not expressly set forth in this Agreement is disclaimed.
edits.name: seller_reps

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless the Buyer from and against losses arising from any breach of Seller’s express representations, warranties, or covenants in this Agreement, subject to the following fixed limitations: (a) for claims other than breaches of the Fundamental Representations (defined below), Seller’s indemnity obligations shall survive for twelve (12) months after Closing, the aggregate basket shall be $25,000 on a first-dollar basis, and Seller’s aggregate liability shall be capped at ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price; (b) for breaches of the representations in Section 3(a), 3(b), 3(c), and 3(d) (the “Fundamental Representations”), Seller’s indemnity obligations shall survive until the date that is six (6) years after Closing, the basket shall not apply, and Seller’s aggregate liability shall be capped at one hundred percent (100%) of the Purchase Price; and (c) claims arising from fraud or intentional misconduct shall not be subject to the foregoing limitations. The parties agree that the indemnity is the exclusive remedy for breach of this Agreement except in cases of fraud or as otherwise expressly provided herein.
edits.name: indemnity
